title: Privacy
description: How Snapped Up handles your data.
body:
We keep this short because we collect very little.

## What we collect

- **No accounts, no sign-ups.** We don't ask for your name or email to read the site.
- **No advertising cookies from us.** Snapped Up itself doesn't set tracking cookies.
- **Basic, anonymous visitor counts.** We may use privacy-friendly analytics that count page views without cookies or identifying you.

## When you click a deal

When you click through to a retailer, that retailer (and the affiliate network, such as Amazon, eBay Partner Network or Awin) may set cookies so they can tell that you came from us. That's covered by **their** privacy policies, so please check them.

## Hosting

The site is hosted on Cloudflare, which processes standard technical data such as IP addresses to deliver pages and keep the site secure.

## Contact

Questions about your data? Email [hello@snappedupdeals.co.uk](mailto:hello@snappedupdeals.co.uk).

*Last updated: 18 October 2026*
